Class RcxLink

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.rcx.RcxLink
public final class RcxLink extends Object
The RCX infrared framing: a message is 55 FF 00 followed by the opcode, its arguments and a checksum, each byte followed by its complement. Plain Java on top of Infrared.

    • sendChannelTone

      public void sendChannelTone(int channel, int frequencyHz, int durationCentiseconds)
      Transmits a tone to one channel of Juno's channelized RCX firmware. Channels are numbered 1..5; the selected channel is encoded in the otherwise unused opcode range, so ordinary RCX commands are unchanged. The command does not wait for a reply because non-selected bricks intentionally ignore it.
